sentences: I'm here to help you through any challenges you may face.
And actually, I think it might be best if we take a slightly different approach with your onboarding.
Your feelings are completely valid, and we want to make sure your onboarding is tailored to your needs and preferences.
Solo projects can be a great way to get comfortable with our processes, the code base, and the tools we use.
Don't worry, we'll still have regular check-ins, and I'll be available for any questions or guidance you may need.
For your first project, I want you to work on enhancing our data visualization tools.
Given your preference for working independently, I want you to focus on individual tasks and solo projects for now.
It's a best practice that we follow here at STARTED to handle potential exceptions and errors gracefully.
Remember, we're a team, and we're always here to support each other.
If you have any questions or concerns along the way, don't hesitate to reach out to me or your colleagues.
